impact: NVENC probe fails at runtime with NvEncodeAPICreateInstance status 15 (nvenc-api-create-failed:15). T-024 implemented the NVENC backend and unit tests passed (including nvenc_probe_available_when_hardware_present on RTX 4080 SUPER / driver 595.71.05), but the runtime probe in VAL-CAP-004 rerun 5 (2026-05-19T06:59:35Z) returned unavailable. encoder.selected was never emitted. Blocks VAL-CAP-004 encoder gate and T-021 green verdict.
resolution:
Probe-layer cause `nvenc-api-create-failed:15` fixed end-to-end across commits 9a5ff33 and 1260dd2.

Root causes fixed (helper/src/encoder/backends/nvenc/ffi.rs and mod.rs):
1. Wrong NVENC version-word formula corrected to `nvencapi_struct_version(N) = NVENCAPI_VERSION | (N << 16) | (0x7 << 28)`.
2. `NV_ENC_ERR_INVALID_VERSION` constant corrected from 7 to 15 (SDK 12.1).
3. `NV_ENC_DEVICE_TYPE_CUDA` corrected from 2 (OPENGL) to 1 (CUDA).
4. Six encode-path version constants centralised in ffi.rs.
5. Encode-path struct layouts (`NV_ENC_INITIALIZE_PARAMS`, `NV_ENC_PIC_PARAMS`, `NV_ENC_LOCK_BITSTREAM`) fixed to SDK 12.1.

All fixes committed. `nvenc_one_frame_shm_encode_produces_fmp4_fragment` passes. Full crate test suite 23/23 green.

T-021 rerun 6 (2026-05-19) confirmed NVENC works in production: `encoder.probeResult` returns `available: true`, `encoder.selected` fires with `backend: nvenc` on RTX 4080 SUPER / driver 595.71.05. VAL-CAP-004 reached the encoder gate successfully — failure is cell mismatch (4K vs 1080p), not NVENC.
title: VAL-CAP-004 encoder.selected gate fails — encoder backends report not-implemented-yet (T-017a)
